ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two vertical blue straight lines, with points Q and T on the left straight line, and points R and S on the right straight line. Segment QR and segment TS are two parallel lines slanting downward to the right. Angle 1 is marked near point Q, located between the left vertical line and the upper slanted line QR; angle 8 is marked near point S, located between the right vertical line and the lower slanted line TS. The problem gives QR ∥ TS, QT ∥ RS, and m∠1 = 131. Reasoning: Because QT ∥ RS, and QR is their transversal, ∠1 and ∠6 are alternate interior angles, m∠1 = m∠6. Also because QR ∥ TS, and RS is their transversal, ∠6 and ∠8 are corresponding angles, m∠6 = m∠8. Therefore m∠8 = m∠1 = 131.

raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $QR \| TS$, $QT \| RS$, and $m\angle 1 = 131$. Find the measure of $\angle 8$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two vertical parallel lines QT and RS, with two slanted parallel segments QR and TS. Angle 1 is at Q between QT and QR, and angle 8 is at S between RS and TS. Use QR as a transversal of the parallel lines QT and RS: angle 1 equals angle 6 by alternate interior angles. Then use RS as a transversal of the parallel lines QR and TS: angle 6 equals angle 8 by corresponding angles. Therefore angle 8 equals angle 1, so m∠8 = 131.

推理：因为 QT ∥ RS，且 QR 是它们的截线，所以 ∠1 与 ∠6 是内错角，m∠1 = m∠6。又因为 QR ∥ TS，且 RS 是它们的截线，所以 ∠6 与 ∠8 是对应角，m∠6 = m∠8。因此 m∠8 = m∠1 = 131。

method.method_draft: Read the figure as quadrilateral Q-R-S-T with opposite sides parallel: QR ∥ TS and QT ∥ RS. Therefore QRST is a parallelogram. In the diagram, ∠1 is an exterior angle at Q adjacent to the interior angle at Q, and ∠8 is an exterior angle at S adjacent to the interior angle at S. Opposite interior angles of a parallelogram are equal, so the interior angle at Q equals the interior angle at S. Their adjacent exterior angles are supplementary to equal angles, so those exterior angles are also equal. Hence ∠8 = ∠1 = 131.

推理：因为 QR ∥ TS 且 QT ∥ RS，所以四边形 QRST 是平行四边形。平行四边形的对角相等，因此 Q 点的内角等于 S 点的内角。∠1 与 Q 点内角互为邻补角，∠8 与 S 点内角互为邻补角。相等角的补角也相等，所以 ∠8 = ∠1。已知 m∠1 = 131，因此 m∠8 = 131。
